## Labcoat Leni 8.1

Ong et al. (2011): *I want to be loved (on Facebook)*

Does narcissism predict Facebook behavior, over and above age, sex, grade and extraversion?

- `status` and `profile`: status updates per week, profile picture rating (one model each)
- Block 1: `age`, `sex`, `grade`; block 2: `extraversion`; block 3: `narcissism`

[Data (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_data/data/ong_2011.jasp) · [Results (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_08a.jasp) · [Results (.html)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_08a.html)

## Labcoat Leni 8.2

Chamorro-Premuzic et al. (2008): *Why do you like your lecturers?*

Do students' own traits predict what they want in a lecturer, over and above age and sex?

- `lec_*`: five traits wanted in a lecturer (one model each)
- Block 1: `age`, `sex`; block 2: own traits, `stu_*`

[Data + results (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_08b.jasp) · [Results (.html)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_08b.html)
